caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, facing slightly to the right. The chair is constructed from light brown wood with visible grain patterns, rendered in naturalistic tones of beige, tan, and pale brown. The seat consists of three horizontal, rectangular wooden slats, each showing wood texture and fastened with visible round pegs at the corners. The chair has four sturdy legs, each slightly tapered and connected near the base by curved wooden stretchers, forming an "H" pattern beneath the seat for stability. The backrest is comprised of two vertical side supports topped with a gently curved horizontal rail and a mid-section containing a horizontal slat with two parallel cutout slots. The background is a plain off-white with no other objects or details. Handwritten text near the bottom right corner reads: "Hazel C. Chaplin, Taos, N.M." along with "Fig 61" and "Page 31."
title: Small Wooden Chair
